additional_info.subject: ID0435152-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S3 170003427]MID certified LEM error CRM:02698000304
additional_info.body:
Hi Szilard, good morning.
I checked the charger and the error from LEM is the following:
Please follow the steps and reboot the LEM, until it works, I would say 5 times is enough.
If after these 5 reboots it doesn't work then memory is corrupted and needs to be replaced.
I will wait for your feedback. Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435152-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S3 170003427]MID certified LEM error CRM:02698000304
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
I need a quick help from your side. How do you mean to reboot the LEM meter? (DCBM) just move out the input power cable of the meter or restart the whole charger itself?
30min means the outage time until the meter is off?
Is it might help if I use the companion tool to reinstall the meter?
BR,
Szilard

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435152-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S3 170003427]MID certified LEM error CRM:02698000304
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
after 5 rebootes it is still not working.
Please inform us, what we should order to replace the unit under warranty (MFLB number) and sent the process for it.
Is it enough if we just replace the meter unit and not replacing the sensor unit or we have to replace both?
And question number 2: why the charger is conitiously restarting? Could you check it please and inform me?
Thx,
Szilard

additional_info.subject: ID0435152-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP / S3 170003427]MID certified LEM error CRM:02698000304
additional_info.body:
Hi Szilard,
Then if after those reboots it doesn't work, we need to replace it:
I believe from the title that the LEM must be MID certificated, so it should be this:
I send the spare parts list in attachment for the SID300.
You need to replace both units, otherwise there will be a error of tampering detected if i'm not mistaken and will not work.
Why the charger is constantly rebooting is because of OCPP requests:
From today morning, here, you can see that the outlets were available and received a command for a reboot:
Please check with the backend why they are sending the reboots.
Thanks!
Best regards,
francisco
